IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, loose brown
waves stands full-length against a warm tan
backdrop. She wears a cream ribbed half-zip
sweater with a blue collared shirt peeking out at the
cuffs and neck, a pearl necklace, and black
wide-leg trousers. She holds brown leather gloves
and a black tote. Her expression is calm. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of cream, cornflower blue, and
black. Refined and classic, in the style of a fall
lookbook.
